allReviewedPassages.rawText: The parent authorized a truthful correction to one existing composed-interface seam fixture after independent triage at /private/tmp/ufz-admission-fixture-triage.md. It formerly advertised a consumer as ready despite an unfinished declared dependency with early unblock disabled, while making that producer await consumer dispatch. The corrected fixture admits both tasks with no known edge, then discovers the dependency through plan-rest.missingEdges after consumer dispatch and before producer landing. Both original seam-review assertions remain; additional ordering assertions preserve the original late-producer-landing purpose. Admission was not weakened.
